name: Lease a Bike
note: Bike-leasing platform for companies and their employees, a brand of Bike Mobility Services (BMS), operating in Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Belgium, Sweden and the United States. Rating note: ON HOLD for a maintainer — the PR's 'none' cannot stand. Pon sold a 49% stake in BMS to Volkswagen Financial Services in 2023, with joint control (bms-vwfs-stake). Volkswagen AG's third-largest shareholder is Qatar Holding LLC, wholly owned by the Qatar Investment Authority, with 10.4% of the capital and 17.0% of the voting rights (qatar-holding-vw-stake, qatar-holding-qia-ownership, qia-government-of-qatar-ownership); the sponsor 'volkswagen' is rated concern on this link, with Qatar's documented migrant-worker abuses as the record (qatar-migrant-worker-abuse-2025). Multiplied along the chain (10.4% x 49%), Qatar's effective stake in BMS is about 5.1%, just over METHOD.md's 5% threshold. Whether that longer chain reaches Lease a Bike is a maintainer's call. Pon keeps 51% and is family-owned (pon-family-owned).
